description: RbNa₃SnO₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/a space group. Rb is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.96-3.45 Å. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent SnO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.35 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.99 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent SnO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SnO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.48 Å. Sn is bonded to four O atoms to form SnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.97 Å) and one longer (1.98 Å) Sn-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Rb, four Na, and one Sn atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, three Na, and one Sn atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, three Na, and one Sn atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, three Na, and one Sn atom.
